device_label: Si microring with T-coil inductive peaking, O-band
epitaxy_or_stack: Ring radius 6 um, waveguide width 380 nm, coupling gap 180 nm, coupling length 0.8 um; lateral PN junction, N 1.06e20 and 1.02e19, P 7.14e19 and 5.34e18 cm^-3; on-chip T-coil L1 18 pH, L2 16 pH, RL 20 ohm
modulation_format: PAM4 at 256 Gb/s (TDECQ 0.16 dB, 128 GBd), 416 Gb/s (TDECQ 2.88 dB, 9-tap FFE) and 448 Gb/s (TDECQ 4.96 dB); NRZ 224 Gb/s (SNR 3.12 dB)
driver: Keysight AWG, 1 Vpp single-ended, no driver amplifier stated; PDFA after the chip; 9-tap FFE on the oscilloscope
notes: EO response (Fig. 2(d)) at -2 V bias and 3 dB insertion-loss detuning. Text gives 1 dB bandwidth >110 GHz; the trace stays above -3 dB to its end near 110 GHz, so bw3db is a bound. T-coil L1 18 pH, L2 16 pH, RL 20 ohm. PAM4 416 Gb/s is 208 GBd by arithmetic (baud not stated); a 448 Gb/s PAM4 eye is also shown (TDECQ 4.96 dB). Chip output about -9 dBm before the PDFA; fiber coupling loss not given. Resonance optical bandwidth about 100 GHz (Q about 2300). Not reported: on-chip IL, launch power, energy per bit, capacitance values, fab, SOI thickness, junction length.

Comparison MRM without inductors: 3 dB EO bandwidth 64 GHz at -2 V bias and 3 dB insertion-loss detuning (Fig. 2(d), blue). Authors do not state whether it is the same ring as bao2026a-a, so only the bandwidth is entered.

device_label: Si microdisk modulator (extended depletion), O-band, one channel of 16-channel array
epitaxy_or_stack: Disk radius 4.1 um, waveguide width 380 nm, coupling gap 180 nm, arc-shaped coupling region +/-12 deg; extended-depletion lateral PN, N 1.0e20, 1.0e19, 3.8e17 and P 7.1e19, 5.3e18, 2.1e17 cm^-3, P++ at disk centre; independent metal heater per channel
modulation_format: PAM4 256 Gb/s per channel on all 16 channels, 16 x 256 Gb/s = 4 Tb/s per fiber; TDECQ 2.68 to 3.24 dB with 9-tap FFE on the oscilloscope; no BER reported
driver: Keysight M8199B AWG, 2 Vpp single-ended via bias-tee and RF probe pads; no driver amplifier stated; PDFA after the chip
notes: Representative disk of the 16-channel array; Fig. 2(b)-(d) show one channel at -2 V. Array: Q 3200 to 3700 and about 1.14 nm (200 GHz) spacing after thermal tuning. Each channel 256 Gb/s PAM4 at 2 Vpp (128 GBd by arithmetic, not stated), TDECQ 2.68 to 3.24 dB, 16 x 256 = 4 Tb/s per fiber. Junction capacitance 8 fF from S11 versus about 14 fF for a racetrack MRM. Per-channel output about -8 dBm before the PDFA. Static ER is the Fig. 2(b) dip depth below the 0 dB baseline at 0 V. Not reported: IL, energy per bit, fab, SOI thickness, launch power.

device_label: Si TW-MZM, CLTW GSSG, 2.5 mm, -3 V bias, with SiGe BW-boost driver
substrate: 300 mm SOI wafer, 220 nm silicon, 2 um BOX
epitaxy_or_stack: Series push-pull, two 2.5 mm phase shifters; GSSG capacitive-loaded TW electrode with periodic loading, Fig. 2(b) labels Td 4, Tp 50, Th 5, Tl 47, Tg 3 um (definitions not in text); customized doping for linearity
modulation_format: 112 GBaud eyes: NRZ 112 Gb/s (ER 4.05 dB), PAM4 224 Gb/s (ER 3.38 dB, RLM 94.4%, TDECQ 1.25 dB), PAM6 280 Gb/s, PAM8 336 Gb/s; 10-tap FFE; no BER reported
driver: 90 nm SiGe BiCMOS distributed driver with 4.1 dB CTLE peaking at 62 GHz, 3.2 Vppd, 40 ohm back termination, wire-bonded to the MZM; Keysight M8199A AWG input; 831 mW total
notes: 40.8 GHz labels the plotted -3 V trace (also one wafer-map die); text calls it the median but the inset median is 38.0 GHz (max 43.0, bias unlabeled). VpiL 1.5 V cm is stated as modulation efficiency; bias, DC/RF and definition not given. Total 831 mW (driver included) over 336 Gb/s is the stated 2.47 pJ/b. Simulated overall E/O bandwidth above 70 GHz with the driver CTLE (Fig. 3(e)) is not entered. Design Z0 65 ohm; text also calls the MZM 33 ohm. Not reported: wavelength, Vpi in V, on-chip IL, electrode metal, optical power.

device_label: Si TW-MZM, CLTW GSSG, 2.5 mm, -6 V bias
notes: Same MZM as deng2026a-a at -6 V reverse bias: EO bandwidth label 52.9 GHz (Fig. 2(d), blue; text calls it the median). Only the bandwidth is bias-specific and entered; no system demonstration at this bias.

device_label: Si push-pull MZM, slow-wave GSGSG, S-shape PN, -1 V bias, O-band
epitaxy_or_stack: S-shape PN junction with junction boundary shifted toward the N region (wider P region); low rib doping, optimized contact and intermediate implants; GSGSG slow-wave T-teeth electrodes with on-chip series poly-R/C AC termination; thermal phase shifters in both arms
modulation_format: PAM4 at -1 V bias, 7-tap FFE, BER target 3.8e-3: 160 Gb/s TDECQ 1.3 dB (3.2 Vppd); 200 Gb/s TDECQ 2.9 dB (3.2 Vppd) and 1.6 dB (2.65 Vppd); 240 Gb/s TDECQ 3.1 dB (1.92 Vppd)
driver: No integrated driver; external electrical drive with amplifiers and switches (models not stated), 3.2 Vppd, 19 percent reflection at the MZM input
notes: VpiL 1.80 V cm (std 0.016) and propagation loss 10.3 dB/cm (median, std 0.15) are 10-lot statistics (Fig. 2); bias and per-arm versus MZM definition not stated. Bandwidth 61 GHz is the -1 V average (Fig. 3(a)); lot median 61, std 3 GHz. ER 3.2 dB measured with about 19% input reflection (1.3 Vpp per arm effective); text also cites 3.7 dB 'DC ER' for matched drive, basis unclear, not entered. Length, wavelength, IL not stated. No integrated driver; matched on-chip driver is future work. 240 Gb/s PAM4 is 120 GBd by arithmetic, not stated; drive_vpp_v 3.2 refers to the 160 and 200 Gb/s eyes. Z0 70 ohm is the differential impedance.

device_label: Si push-pull MZM, slow-wave GSGSG, S-shape PN, -2 V bias, O-band
notes: Same MZM at -2 V bias: Fig. 3(b) traces stay above -3 dB to the 67 GHz limit, text states >67 GHz. Slight peaking from under-termination at higher line impedance.

device_label: Si PCW slow-light MZM, N = 3 segments, with EO equalizer
epitaxy_or_stack: Triangular-lattice SiO2-filled hole PCW, lattice a 404 nm, hole diameter 230 nm; p-n doped NA 9.5e17, ND 1.0e18 cm^-3; N = 3 segments with delay lines and crossing (FIR equalizer, negative tap)
notes: Paper states f3dB about 80 GHz, but the -3 dB point is reached only on the dashed extrapolation (fit of the last 10 GHz); the measured trace ends near 66 GHz at about -0.4 dB. Entered as bound. Response peaks near +6 dB around 40-45 GHz. Footprint 0.60 x 0.65 mm. VpiL 0.32 V cm is cited from earlier work, not entered. Not reported: length, wavelength, Vpi, IL.

device_label: Si PCW slow-light MZM, N = 3 segments, without EO equalizer
notes: Reference response of the N = 3 device without the equalizer; trace ends near 66 GHz at about -9.5 dB and crosses -3 dB near 36-37 GHz on the plot, label reads 35 GHz.

device_label: Si PCW slow-light MZM, N = 4 segments, with EO equalizer (transmission device)
epitaxy_or_stack: Triangular-lattice SiO2-filled hole PCW, lattice a 404 nm, hole diameter 230 nm; p-n doped NA 9.5e17, ND 1.0e18 cm^-3; N = 4 segments with delay lines and crossing
modulation_format: OOK DSP-free 100 Gb/s (TDEC 1.8 dB, 2.3 V) and 112 Gb/s (TDEC 2.7 dB, 2.0 V); OOK 140 Gb/s with 11-tap FFE (TDEC 2.5 dB, 1.8 V); PAM4 DSP-free 160 Gb/s (TDECQ 1.6 dB) and 180 Gb/s (TDECQ 2.2 dB); PAM4 200 Gb/s with 11-tap FFE (TDECQ 1.5 dB); SD-FEC reference BER 2e-2; no BER reported
driver: Keysight M8199B AWG with broadband amplifier and probe; no integrated driver; receiver-side 11-tap FFE where stated
notes: drive_vpp_v refers to 112 Gb/s OOK; the 200 Gb/s PAM4 max rate used 4.2-5.2 Vpp. N = 4 device used for the eyes; its EO response is not shown. OOK 112 Gb/s DSP-free at Vpp about 2 V; PAM4 uses Vpp 4.2 to 5.2 V (Fig. 3 caption, per-rate mapping not given). Baud not stated (PAM4 200 Gb/s is 100 GBd by arithmetic). 13 dBm laser light coupled via lensed fiber and edge coupler; on-chip power not stated. Not reported: length, wavelength, Vpi, energy per bit, bandwidth of this device.
